headline: ARI @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 3.88 at TEX 3.77, with a projected total of 7.65. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved -0.01 runs while TEX moved -1.08, changing the projected margin by +1.07 runs. The projected total fell -1.09, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Zac Gallen has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Ezequiel Duran, Ildemaro Vargas, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Corey Seager, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
